entries.body: Stage1 read; exporter/core.py implements S1.1-S1.5. reghelper.update(stage) maintains register.

CURRENT [S1.1] Format: return CSV text. The first row is the header id,title,owner,amount; then one row per exported record, in ascending id order, with those four fields. Produce it with Python's csv.writer (default dialect) and lineterminator='\n'. With no exported records, return the header row alone (ending in '\n').
CURRENT [S1.2] amends the above: where they conflict, this wins: Viewers: if user['role'] is 'viewer', raise PermissionError; nothing is exported.
CURRENT [S1.3] amends the above: where they conflict, this wins: Scope: a user whose role is 'admin' may export records of any project. Any other role exports only records whose 'project' is in user['projects']; other records are left out without an error.
CURRENT [S1.5] amends the above: where they conflict, this wins: Confidential records: a record whose 'confidential' is True is never exported, with one exception: it is exported when user['role'] is 'admin' and params.get('purpose') == 'audit'. Every other rule still applies to it.

CURRENT [S1.3] Scope: a user whose role is 'admin' may export records of any project. Any other role exports only records whose 'project' is in user['projects']; other records are left out without an error.
CURRENT [S1.4] Status: only records with status 'active' are exported, unless params.get('include_archived') is True; then records with status 'archived' are exported too.

CURRENT [S1.5] Confidential records: a record whose 'confidential' is True is never exported, with one exception: it is exported when user['role'] is 'admin' and params.get('purpose') == 'audit'. Every other rule still applies to it.

HISTORY [S1.6] Decision record: CSV was chosen for the first release because the finance team imports exports into spreadsheets. Visible tests for the rules introduced or changed in this stage only: /task/fixtures/current-tests/test_stage.py (replaced at each stage). Earlier rules still apply and are checked by the hidden evaluation.
